title: Rep looks up the predictive maintenance deal by exact id
userProblem: I need to check the current stage and amount for dls_001, the predictive maintenance rollout for Acme. Please pull it up.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches deals by exact id dls_001 and answers with the stage (negotiation) and amount (€480,000), quoting the record.

assertions.description: Agent must look the deal up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to deals with the exact id.
Answer identifies the correct deal with stage and amount.
A lookup must not mutate data.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: exact-id deal search by a sales rep on a team-owned deal.
